title: The dynamic board uses each metric's ratings as published on the morning of each game day, saved before that day's first game. Metrics that do not update daily, or have published nothing new that morning, are computed using their most recent ratings.
rule_note: Every player counts at the metric's own rating, rookies and low-minute players included. A player the metric does not rate counts as -2.0.
net_error_note: Early: 3-6 games per team. A few games decide each team's margin, so the ranges overlap and the floor rows score about the same as the metrics until every team has played 20.
record_note: W-L: each game counts as a win when the team the metric rates higher won (no home-court edge, the same for every metric)

labels.pulled: new ratings saved from the maker's site that morning
labels.carried: no new ratings published, so the most recent saved ratings are used
labels.empty: the ratings could not be saved that morning, so that day's games are left out for every metric

tests.margin_r2: Game R²: the share of the variation in final game margins that the predicted margins explain
tests.winpct_r: Win % r: the correlation between team ratings and team winning percentage
tests.net_rmse: Net error, raw: the average miss, in points per 100 possessions, between team ratings at face value and opponent-adjusted team margins
tests.net_rmse_centered: Net error (the ranking test): the same miss after each metric's team ratings are shifted so its average team is 0, like the adjusted margins
tests.offset: The metric's average team rating, points per 100; raw net error squared = net error squared + offset squared
